intents.intent: Find local repair volunteers and a space coordinator to explore a monthly Leeds repair cafe that helps neighbors keep useful belongings in use.
Meet Leeds organizers who want to plan practical neighbor support during hot weather, linking a simple check-in rota with clear information about cool public places.
Find neighbors who can help make a clear, multilingual guide to shaded routes and cool public places in Leeds, grounded in what people can actually reach and use.
Exchange plain-language editing with local repair organizers: I can simplify visitor instructions and want to learn how to make a welcoming community event work.
Find a community energy organizer who needs help making public, aggregated energy data understandable before deciding which local efficiency ideas deserve further investigation.
Find a community educator to co-design a beginner session on reading energy charts, combining my data skills with their experience helping people learn together.
Find a community or climate project with a budget for plain-language resource information, including testing whether residents can understand the next step.
Meet Leeds neighbors who want to repair clothes together at a small volunteer mending circle, sharing simple hand-sewing skills and conversation.
Find a local organizer who can bring neighbors and a suitable space together for a small bicycle repair session; I can share practical skills that keep bikes in everyday use.
Meet neighbors and data-minded volunteers to make everyday knowledge about summer comfort useful: notice places to rest, compare observations, and explain findings in plain language.
Find an analyst who can help our community group turn area-level energy figures into questions residents can discuss before choosing a local efficiency project.
Find community climate project organizers interested in exploring a commercial carbon-credit program with formal emissions measurement and a multi-year commitment.
Find neighbors interested in practical climate resilience through a shared growing and compost project, starting by finding a site and a team willing to look after it over time.
Meet local organizers and practical skill-sharers to explore a small Sunday repair or mending event at a Leeds makerspace, subject to agreeing a workable scope with its committee.
